title: Number System
tagline: Factors, HCF-LCM, remainders — the topic most exams underestimate.

subsections.title: Factors, LCM-HCF & Divisibility
subsections.trick: 1 is not prime — examiners plant this constantly in ‘how many prime factors’ questions. For ‘least number leaving remainder r with x, y, z’, always compute LCM(x,y,z) first and add r — never r first.

formulas.label: Least number leaving remainder r with x, y, z

subsections.title: Factors of a Composite Number
subsections.trick: Write N = aᵐ×bⁿ×cᵖ... first, always — every formula on this page is a one-line plug-in once you have the prime factorisation, so that's the only genuinely hard step.
